148:t_105:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Shut up, $$サルディアス・アクス$$! This way of yours, treating even people's hearts as targets to win...!」

148:t_105:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This revulsion...! It's like being shown my old self!」

148:t_105:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh... so that's what this is about. But in that case, you've got the wrong man.」

148:t_105:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I'm not the one who devised the operation to destroy the hearts of the people of $$新日本$$, you see.」

148:t_106:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Now here's a true professional. Young as you are, I'd say you've been through quite a few hells.」

148:t_106:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have no intention of talking with the enemy. I will eliminate you swiftly.」

148:t_106:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...I thought as much. Then I'll devote myself to my duties as well.」

148:t_107:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You went to a lot of trouble pulling that stunt on us! I'll give you a proper thank-you for everything so far!」

148:t_107:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「My, my... how polite of you. If you're that pleased, then all my running around to set things up was worth it.」

148:t_107:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「It's no use trying to fog me with that kind of act!」

148:t_107:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Here I come, $$サイデリアル$$! I'll hit you with the anger of the people of $$新日本$$ in their place!」

148:t_107:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... It's precisely that kind of Japanese sentimentality that made that operation a success, you know...」

148:t_108:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「In terms of efficiency, your operation can only be called magnificent.」

148:t_108:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I'm honored by your kind words.」

148:t_108:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But personally, I can only call it repugnant. I reject anyone who builds into their tactics something that tears open old wounds of the heart...!」

148:t_108:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... a natural reaction, I suppose. I have no intention of making excuses.」

148:t_108:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「What a pity. If you have such a sound sensibility, I wish you had held to it...!」

148:t_108:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But it's too late now...! You have angered me!」

148:t_109:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Still, what a twist of fate... To think I'd end up fighting someone from the $$アストラギウス$$ Galaxy in a place like this.」

148:t_109:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Forgive me... This is hardly the mood for small talk.」

148:t_109:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then I'll get on with my mission quickly as well.」

148:t_110:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you understand the difference in power, hurry up and raise the white flag. You don't want to die, do you?」

148:t_110:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I know, you see. For all your fine words, you're always living with despair.」

148:t_110:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「No, I don't plan to. If you ask me, you've got it better, since you can still hold on to hope.」

148:t_110:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This overwhelming emotion... Hatred that swallows everything...」

148:t_110:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you won't follow us, I'll just hurry up and release the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$...!」

148:t_110:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Before that, I'll repaint the hope and despair inside you in nothing but despair!」

148:t_111:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$! You will fall by my hand!」

148:t_111:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I like it, that naked hatred. You're a person close to me.」

148:t_111:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「True, I once lived with hatred, and because of it I hurt the people who mattered to me...!」

148:t_111:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「To never repeat the regret of that time, I will not fight out of hatred!」

148:t_111:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「How ridiculous. If you don't fight on emotion, what's the meaning of your fight?」

148:t_111:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The meaning of my fight... is the hope that was entrusted to me! For that, I... $$ゼロ$$ exists!」

148:t_112:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The battle at $$セントラル・ベース$$ in North America...」

148:t_112:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「We suffered defeat before the power of that man, $$バルビエル$$...!」

148:t_112:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If we don't defeat that man, the war enveloping the world will never end! Let's go, $$刹那$$!」

148:t_112:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「We are $$ソレスタルビーイング$$...! We fight to eradicate war from this world!」

148:t_113:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「You just wait, $$バルビエル$$!」

148:t_113:1.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「The poison from that machine nearly wiped out the $$連邦軍$$ that were fighting alongside us...!」

148:t_113:2.en:
$$ピーリス$$
「And with that man's power to amplify hatred, the army's organization was driven to the brink of collapse...!」

148:t_113:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「We'll pay that debt back here! Get ready, you scorpion bastard!」

148:t_114:0.en:
$$グラハム$$
(Boy... I will fight at your side...)

148:t_114:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
(And someday, I will proudly call myself your comrade-in-arms...!)

148:t_114:2.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Ease up, Lightning. Strain yourself too hard and the Grim Reaper will latch onto you.」

148:t_114:3.en:
$$グラハム$$
「As expected of Immortal $$コーラサワー$$. I appreciate the advice.」

148:t_114:4.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Anyway, once you're dead, it's over! Let's survive and fight to the very end!」

148:t_114:5.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「And let's pay that scorpion bastard back for what he did in North America!」

148:t_114:6.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Understood! $$グラハム・エーカー$$, going in!」

148:t_115:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
($$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... The Scorpio $$スフィア・リアクター$$...)

148:t_115:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
($$ガドライト#pilot$$ was a member of the $$サイデリアル$$ too, and there's also that man, $$尸空#pilot$$...)

148:t_115:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(How many more Reactors can the $$サイデリアル$$ have...?)
